title: Guided Notes

vocab.Data cycle: The four repeating stages of a study --- formulate, collect, organize, analyze and communicate. Each stage can use only what the stage before it handed over.
vocab.Statistical question: A question whose answers vary from one individual to the next, that names the group it is about, and that says what will be recorded for each one.
vocab.Variable of interest: The characteristic the question says you will record for each individual. The question names it before any data exist.
vocab.Relative frequency: A count divided by the total, written as a decimal or a percent --- the share of the whole that one category makes up.
